mapper.select: SELECT h.* FROM hls_duration_hd h WHERE h.project_id = #{projectId}
SELECT t.* FROM hls_duration_ln t, con_contract_cashflow c WHERE t.contract_id = c.contract_id AND c.due_date > t.et_date AND c.received_amount != 0 and c.CF_STATUS != 'BLACK' and t.hd_id = #{hdId}

select pp.project_id, pp.LEASE_ITEM_ID, hli.FULL_NAME as LEASE_ITEM_ID_N, hli.LEASE_ITEM_CODE, hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE, (select meaning from sys_code_value_b_v where code = 'HLS.COLLATERAL_TYPE' and code_value = hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE) LEASE_ITEM_TYPE_N, hli.PATTERN, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'HLS.PATTERN' AND code_value = hli.PATTERN ) PATTERN_N, hli.MORTGAGOR, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = hli.MORTGAGOR ) MORTGAGOR_N,
hli.PLEDGE_STATE, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v WHERE CODE = 'PLEDGE_STATE0' AND code_value = hli.PLEDGE_STATE ) PLEDGE_STATE_N, (select a.EVALUATION_VALUE from (select hlid.lease_item_id, sum(hlid.EVALUATION_VALUE) as EVALUATION_VALUE from hls_lease_item_detail hlid group by hlid.lease_item_id) a where a.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id) ASSET_VALUE_TOTAL,
(select sum(a.v1+a.v2) FROM (select hlid.lease_item_id, sum(hlid.purchase_price) as v1,sum(hlid.pledge_asset_value) as v2 FROM hls_lease_item_detail hlid group by hlid.lease_item_id) a WHERE a.lease_item_id = hli.lease_item_id) ORIGINAL_ASSET_VALUE_TOTAL from prj_project_chance_mp pp,hls_lease_item hli
hli.LEASE_ITEM_ID = pp.LEASE_ITEM_ID and hli.enabled_flag = 'Y' and hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE in ('MORTGAGE','PLEDGE') and pp.project_id = #{projectId}

select hcli.project_id, hcli.LEASE_ITEM_ID , hli.FULL_NAME as LEASE_ITEM_ID_N, hli.LEASE_ITEM_CODE , hli.INSTALLATION_SITE as IDENTIFICATION_CITY, hli.DESCRIPTION, hli.vender_id, hli.BRAND, hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE, ( select CASE WHEN ( SELECT max( lal.fair_value ) FROM lease_asset_ln lal WHERE lal.LEASE_ITEM_ID = hlil.LEASE_ITEM_ID ) IS NULL THEN sum( hlil.PRICE*hlil.QUANTITY ) ELSE ( SELECT max( lal.fair_value ) FROM lease_asset_ln lal WHERE lal.LEASE_ITEM_ID = hlil.LEASE_ITEM_ID ) END AS ASSET_VALUE_TOTAL from hls_lease_item_list hlil where hli.LEASE_ITEM_ID = hlil.LEASE_ITEM_ID )NET_ASSET_VALUE_TOTAL, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = hli.vender_id ) VENDER_ID_N, (select scv.MEANING from sys_code_b sc,sys_code_value_b scv where sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID and sc.CODE = 'ASSET_STATUS' and scv.value = hli.asset_status) asset_status_n from prj_project_lease_item hcli,hls_lease_item hli
hli.LEASE_ITEM_ID = hcli.LEASE_ITEM_ID and hli.enabled_flag = 'Y' and hli.LEASE_ITEM_TYPE in ('LEASE') and hcli.project_id = #{projectId}

select t1.*, (t1.net_asset_value_total_now - nvl(t1.release_amount,t1.net_asset_value_total_now)) release_amt from (SELECT t.project_id, i.lease_item_id, i.lease_item_code, i.full_name, (SELECT hbt.description FROM hls_business_type hbt WHERE hbt.document_category = 'ASSET_TYPES' AND hbt.business_type = i.asset_types) asset_types_n, (SELECT hdt.description FROM hls_document_type hdt WHERE hdt.document_category = 'ASSET_TYPES' AND hdt.business_type = i.asset_types AND hdt.document_type = i.asset_types_sub) asset_types_sub_n, (SELECT fc.currency_name FROM fnd_currency fc WHERE fc.currency_code = i.currency) currency_n, (SELECT nvl(SUM(hlid.net_asset_value), 0) FROM hls_lease_item_detail hlid WHERE hlid.lease_item_id = i.lease_item_id) net_asset_value_total, (SELECT nvl(SUM(hlid.net_asset_value), 0) FROM hls_lease_item_detail hlid left join hls_duration_ln ln on (ln.lease_item_detail_id = hlid.lease_item_detail_id and ln.source_type = 'REPURCHASE' and ln.hd_id = #{hdId}) WHERE hlid.lease_item_id = i.lease_item_id) net_asset_value_total_now, (SELECT SUM(nvl(ln.release_amount, 0)) FROM hls_duration_ln ln,hls_lease_item_detail d WHERE ln.source_type = 'REPURCHASE' and ln.hd_id = #{hdId} and ln.lease_item_detail_id = d.lease_item_detail_id and d.lease_item_id = i.lease_item_id) release_amount
FROM prj_project_lease_item t, hls_lease_item i WHERE t.lease_item_id = i.lease_item_id)t1
t1.project_id = #{projectId}
order by t1.lease_item_code

select t1.* from ( SELECT ln.hd_id, ln.ln_id, t.*, (SELECT hdt.description FROM hls_document_type hdt WHERE hdt.document_category = 'WARRANT_TYPE' AND hdt.document_type = t.warrant_type) warrant_type_n, nvl(ln.warrant_flag, 'N') warrant_flag, (case when ln.warrant_flag ='Y' then '是' else '否' end) warrant_flag_n, (case when ln.warrant_flag = 'Y' then 1 else 2 end) order_seq,
(SELECT hbt.description FROM hls_business_type hbt WHERE hbt.document_category = 'WARRANT_TYPE' AND hbt.business_type = t.file_type) file_type_n,
(SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_INOUT_STATUS' AND scv.value = t.warrant_status) warrant_status_n, (SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_DOCUMENT_TYPE' AND scv.value = t.document_type) document_type_n, (SELECT scv.MEANING FROM sys_code_b sc, sys_code_value_b scv WHERE sc.CODE_ID = scv.CODE_ID AND sc.CODE = 'WARRANT_DOCUMENT_CLASS' AND scv.value = t.document_class) document_class_n,
(SELECT wm_concat(fa.attachment_id) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' AND t.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value) attachment_id,
(SELECT wm_concat(fa.file_name) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' AND t.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value) file_name,
(SELECT MAX(fa.creation_date) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' AND t.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value) upload_date,
(SELECT MAX(su.description) FROM fnd_atm_attachment fa, fnd_atm_attachment_multi fam, sys_user su WHERE fa.attachment_id = fam.attachment_id AND fam.table_name = 'HLS_LEASE_ITEM_WARRANT' AND t.warrant_id = fam.table_pk_value AND su.user_id = fa.created_by) upload_person, (SELECT sc.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v sc WHERE sc.code = 'BP.BP_MASTER_ROLE_CARD' AND sc.code_value = t.bp_type) bp_type_n FROM hls_lease_item_warrant t LEFT JOIN (select * from hls_duration_ln l where l.hd_id = #{hdId}) ln ON t.warrant_id = ln.warrant_id) t1
t1.project_id = #{projectId}
order by order_seq,warrant_name

SELECT c.finance_amount, c.int_rate, t.et_date, c.vat_rate AS tax_rate, to_char(c.inception_of_lease, 'yyyy/mm/dd') inception_of_lease, (SELECT v.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'EARLY_TERMINATION_CODE' AND v.code_value = t.et_type) et_type, t.et_ratio, t.et_pre_amount, t.et_exempt_amount FROM hls_duration_ln t, con_contract c WHERE t.contract_id = c.contract_id and t.ln_id = #{lnId}

SELECT c.finance_amount, c.int_rate, t.prepayment_date, c.vat_rate AS tax_rate, to_char(c.inception_of_lease, 'yyyy/mm/dd') inception_of_lease, (SELECT v.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'EARLY_TERMINATION_CODE' AND v.code_value = t.prepayment_type) prepayment_type_n, t.prepayment_ratio, t.prepayment_principal_flag, t.prepayment_exempt_amount, t.prin_at_cd, c.lpr_link_date as alt_lpr_ref_day, c.base_rate as alt_base_rate FROM hls_duration_ln t, con_contract c WHERE t.contract_id = c.contract_id and t.ln_id = #{lnId}

SELECT t.change_date change_date_in, t.change_date, t.prin_at_cd prin_at_cd_in, t.prin_at_cd, t.change_start_time change_start_time_in, t.change_start_time, t.unreceived_fine_amt unreceived_fine_amt_in, t.unreceived_fine_amt, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND v.code_value = nvl( t.fine_reorganized_flag, 'N' ) ) fine_reorganized_flag_n, t.residual_prin_at_cd residual_prin_at_cd_in, t.residual_prin_at_cd , t.month_after_alt month_after_alt_in, t.month_after_alt, t.alt_base_rate_type alt_base_rate_type_in, t.alt_base_rate_type, t.alt_base_rate_collect, t.alt_base_rate_collect alt_base_rate_collect_in, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'RENTING_FREQUENCY' AND v.code_value = t.alt_renting_frequency ) alt_renting_frequency_n, t.alt_renting_frequency alt_renting_frequency_in, t.alt_renting_frequency, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'PAY_TYPE' AND v.code_value = t.alt_pay_type ) alt_pay_type_n, t.alt_pay_type, t.alt_lease_times alt_lease_times_in, t.alt_lease_times, T.alt_lpr_ref_day alt_lpr_ref_day_in, T.alt_lpr_ref_day, t.alt_base_rate alt_base_rate_in, t.alt_base_rate, t.alt_floating_way_rate alt_floating_way_rate_in, t.alt_floating_way_rate, T.alt_int_rate alt_int_rate_in, T.alt_int_rate, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'CALC_DATE_TYPE' AND v.code_value = t.alt_calc_date_type ) alt_calc_date_type_n, t.alt_rental_pay_date alt_rental_pay_date_in, t.alt_rental_pay_date, t.alt_int_rate_type alt_int_rate_type_in, t.alt_int_rate_type, ( SELECT s.MEANING FROM sys_code_value_b_v s WHERE s. CODE = 'CON.INT_RATE_TYPE' AND s.code_value = t.ALT_INT_RATE_TYPE )alt_int_rate_type_n, t.ALT_BASE_RATE_TYPE AS ALT_BASE_RATE_TYPE_n, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'RENTAL_ROUNDING_TYPE' AND v.code_value = t.alt_rental_rounding_type ) alt_rental_rounding_type_n, t.alt_renting_fre_custom, t.alt_grace_lease_term FROM hls_duration_ln t, con_contract c WHERE t.contract_id = c.contract_id and t.ln_id = #{lnId}

SELECT t.change_date change_date_in, t.prin_at_cd prin_at_cd_in, t.unreceived_fine_amt unreceived_fine_amt_in, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND v.code_value = nvl(t.fine_reorganized_flag, 'N')) fine_reorganized_flag_n, t.residual_prin_at_cd residual_prin_at_cd_in, t.month_after_alt month_after_alt_in, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'RENTING_FREQUENCY' AND v.code_value = t.alt_renting_frequency) alt_renting_frequency_n, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'PAY_TYPE' AND v.code_value = t.alt_pay_type) alt_pay_type_n, t.alt_lease_times alt_lease_times_in, T.alt_lpr_ref_day alt_lpr_ref_day_in, t.alt_base_rate alt_base_rate_in, t.alt_floating_way_rate alt_floating_way_rate_in, T.alt_int_rate alt_int_rate_in, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'CALC_DATE_TYPE' AND v.code_value = t.alt_calc_date_type) alt_calc_date_type_n, t.alt_rental_pay_date alt_rental_pay_date_in, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'RENTAL_ROUNDING_TYPE' AND v.code_value = t.alt_rental_rounding_type) alt_rental_rounding_type_n, t.alt_renting_fre_custom, t.alt_grace_lease_term FROM hls_duration_ln t, con_contract c WHERE t.contract_id = c.contract_id and t.ln_id = #{lnId}

select t1.* from (SELECT t.*, c.contract_number AS contract_id_n, c.finance_amount, (select hpl.description from hls_price_list hpl where hpl.price_list = t.et_price_list) et_price_list_n, (select hpl.description from hls_price_list hpl where hpl.price_list = t.prepayment_price_list) prepayment_price_list_n, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'EARLY_TERMINATION_CODE' AND v.code_value = t.et_type) et_type_n, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'EARLY_TERMINATION_CODE' AND v.code_value = t.prepayment_type) prepayment_type_n, (SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.code = 'SYS.YES_NO' AND v.code_value = t.prepayment_principal_flag) prepayment_principal_flag_n,
(SELECT SUM(ccc.principal - nvl(ccc.received_principal, 0)) FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.contract_id = c.contract_id AND ccc.cf_item = 1 AND ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE') AS residual_principal FROM hls_duration_ln t, con_contract c WHERE t.contract_id = c.contract_id AND t.source_type = 'PREPAYMENT')t1
t1.ln_id = #{lnId}
order by t1.ln_id

SELECT l.hd_id, l.ln_id, l.bp_id, l.bp_type, l.bank_account_id, bp.bp_class, bp.bp_code, bp.bp_code as bp_code_n, bp.bp_name, bp.bp_name as bp_id_n, (select hbt.description from hls_bp_type hbt where hbt.BP_TYPE = l.bp_type) bp_type_n, (SELECT bba.bank_account_name FROM hls_bp_master_bank_account bba WHERE bba.bank_account_id = l.bank_account_id) bank_account_id_n, (SELECT bba.bank_account_num FROM hls_bp_master_bank_account bba WHERE bba.bank_account_id = l.bank_account_id) bank_account_num, (SELECT bba.bank_full_name FROM hls_bp_master_bank_account bba WHERE bba.bank_account_id = l.bank_account_id) bank_full_name FROM hls_duration_ln l, hls_bp_master bp
l.bp_id = bp.bp_id AND l.source_type = 'BP_INFO' and l.hd_id = #{hdId}

SELECT min(c.times) CHANGE_START_TIME, ( SELECT q.lease_times FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id ) ALT_LEASE_TIMES, ( SELECT q.lease_term FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id ) MONTH_AFTER_ALT, ( SELECT q.RENTING_FREQUENCY FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id ) ALT_RENTING_FREQUENCY, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s,prj_quotation q where s.CODE = 'RENTING_FREQUENCY' and s.code_value = q.RENTING_FREQUENCY and q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id)ALT_RENTING_FREQUENCY_n, ( SELECT q.RENTAL_PAY_DATE FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id ) ALT_RENTAL_PAY_DATE, ( SELECT q.INT_RATE_TYPE FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id ) ALT_INT_RATE_TYPE, (select s.MEANING from sys_code_value_b_v s,prj_quotation q where s.CODE = 'CON.INT_RATE_TYPE' and s.code_value = q.INT_RATE_TYPE and q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id)ALT_INT_RATE_TYPE_n, ( SELECT q.BASE_RATE_COLLECT FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id ) ALT_BASE_RATE_COLLECT, (SELECT fb.DESCRIPTION AS value_name FROM fnd_base_rate_set fb,prj_quotation q where fb.BASE_RATE_SET = q.BASE_RATE_COLLECT and q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id)ALT_BASE_RATE_COLLECT_n, ( SELECT q.BASE_RATE_TYPE FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id ) ALT_BASE_RATE_TYPE, ( SELECT q.BASE_RATE_TYPE FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id )ALT_BASE_RATE_TYPE_n, ( SELECT q.BASE_RATE FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id ) ALT_BASE_RATE, ( SELECT q.FLOATING_WAY_RATE FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id ) ALT_FLOATING_WAY_RATE, ( SELECT q.int_rate FROM prj_quotation q WHERE q.quotation_id = c.quotation_id ) ALT_INT_RATE, ( SELECT cc.OUTSTANDING_PRINCIPAL FROM con_contract_cashflow cc WHERE cc.contract_id = c.contract_id AND cc.times = c.times - 1 and cc.CF_STATUS = 'RELEASE' AND cc.cf_item in (1,0) ) RESIDUAL_PRIN_AT_CD FROM con_contract_cashflow c
c.cf_item = 1 AND c.due_date >= #{changeDate} AND c.write_off_flag = 'NOT' and c.CF_STATUS = 'RELEASE' AND c.contract_id = #{contractId}
